meta.title: Margins — summarize and keep what you read
meta.description: Margins is a study library for students: paste text or drop in a PDF and get the summary, and keep texts, documents and images in one place.

nav.signOutError: Could not sign out. Try again.

auth.fragCaptionLogin: Log in, and today's summary is waiting where you left it.
auth.fragCaptionRegister: Create an account, drop your first reading, and keep the points that matter.
auth.fragCaptionForgot: One link, and you are back to your reading.
auth.fragCaptionReset: Save once, and the library is yours again.

register.title: Create account
register.name: Name
register.criteria: At least 8 characters, with one number.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.subA: We sent a verification link to
verify.subGeneric: We sent you a verification link. It expires in 24 hours.

verifyDone.title: Email verified
verifyDone.body: Your email is confirmed. The whole library is yours now.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.sub: Enter the email you study with, and we send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, the reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.
forgot.note: No email provider is configured on this server yet — in development the message is written to the server's mail outbox instead.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.criteria: At least 8 characters, with one number.
reset.done: Password updated. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.

errors.INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD: Email or password is not correct.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email first — we can resend the link.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: If that email has an account, the reset link is on its way.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: That password is too short (at least 8 characters).
errors.RATE_LIMIT: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

auth.genericError: That didn't work. Check the details and try again.

summary.coverageNote: The AI checked its notes against the source. Listed gaps are parts it could not confidently cover — never invented content.
